optimize_model_for_inference: optimize a PyTorch model for inference using model_opt.optimize with eval mode and sample input
optimize_model_for_training: optimize a PyTorch model for training using model_opt.optimize with an optimizer and loss function
test_trivial_eval: test model_opt.optimize on a simple single-parameter module in eval mode and verify output consistency
test_simple_train: test model_opt.optimize on a two-linear-layer module in train mode and verify weight updates
test_alexnet_eval: test model_opt.optimize on torchvision AlexNet in eval mode and verify deterministic inference output
